description: This image is NOT a scientific figure and contains no research data. It is the publisher's "Check for updates" / CrossMark-style graphic: a square thumbnail with a light grey-white background containing a ring composed of alternating blue and yellow-green arc segments, inside which sits a red ribbon/bookmark shape with a notched (swallow-tail) bottom edge. Beneath the symbol, two lines of dark grey sans-serif text read "Check for" and "updates". There are no panels, no axes or units, no scale bar, no legend, no micrograph, spectrum, curve, map, table or schematic of any material process. No sample label, composition, processing condition or numeric value is printed. The image therefore provides zero evidence about low-density δ-ferrite steel, its lamellar δ-ferrite/martensite/ferrite microstructure, or its impact toughness; its only meaning is bibliographic, marking that the article record is linked to an update-checking service. The declared routing of this item as a figure group is a mis-classification by the source PDF layout: no figure content is retrievable here.

subfigures.description: Single non-scientific graphic: a blue-and-yellow segmented ring surrounding a red ribbon/bookmark symbol, with the two-line text "Check for updates" underneath on a light grey-white background. No scientific data of any kind.

observations.observation: The image is a publisher 'Check for updates' watermark/logo graphic, not a scientific figure; it shows a blue-and-yellow segmented ring around a red ribbon symbol with the text 'Check for updates' below.
No axes, axis labels, units, scale bars, legends, panels or data curves are present anywhere in the image.
The image carries no material system, sample label, composition or processing condition, so it cannot be linked to any sample in this paper.
No numeric value or measured quantity is printed in the image.

Because the item contains no figure content, it provides no evidence for the microstructure-toughness relationship discussed in this paper's abstract (δ-ferrite, honeycomb martensite lamellae, equiaxed ferrite from DIFT).
